metric: FOUNDATIONAL-AXIOM-ONLY theorems: kernel Theorems carrying a proof value whose transitive axiom closure contains no DOMAIN-specific axiom. This is the repo's 'prove' rule (CLAUDE.md: closure subseteq FOUNDATIONAL_AXIOMS = {propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice, Eq builtins}), and it is WEAKER than constructive in the ordinary mathematical sense: Classical.choice is foundational here, so a theorem resting on classical choice is counted. The exact exception set is measured on every run into `classical_choice_dependents` and is part of this baseline.
